title: Merchandise Purchases — Finch Note Redeemed but Left Undeducted at Payment
content:
**Rule.** When the Finch Note ledger shows a note redeemed on a Merchandise Purchases purchase record while the purchase record shows no Finch Notes applied and the unit's card was captured as if no note had been used, the card was charged for the part the note had already paid.

**Scope.** For a Finch Note recorded as redeemed on a unit but left undeducted that this policy handles, and only for such a note, the register-error adjustment is still made at any time while the unit is not returned and still counts toward no limit, and it refunds the card money captured for the part the note had paid together with the note service credit and courtesies; every other register error, including a unit rung above its shelf ticket; registry credit recorded as spent but left undeducted; sales tax charged on the part a Finch Note paid; gift card or Bonus Card value recorded as redeemed but left undeducted; and a second capture of the same tender, stays under the base rule or the rule written for it.

**The note itself.** The note is not refunded, reinstated or paid out in money; only the card money captured for the part it had paid is returned, to the unit's original tender, and the correction records no new unit price.

## The rule as condition and result

| What the records show | Result |
|---|---|
| a note redeemed on the purchase record in the Finch Note ledger; no Finch Notes applied on the purchase record; the card captured as if no note had been used | a register-error adjustment returning the card money captured for the note's part, to the original tender |
| the same, with the unit returned | no adjustment — it is made only while the unit is not returned |

The note stays redeemed in every case.

## Booking the refund — `refund_note_shortfall_1f084e1e`

**Capability.** Books a Finch Note shortfall refund on one purchase record: a register-error price adjustment that returns the card money captured for the part of the unit a redeemed Finch Note had already paid, together with any credits owed for it. On success one price adjustment entry with the current date and the reason register price error is added to the unit's records, with no new unit price; the amount goes back to the tender the unit was paid with, and the unit's amount paid and not refunded goes down by the same amount. The note itself stays redeemed. The customer sees the refund on the original tender.

**How it is invoked.** `refund_note_shortfall_1f084e1e` is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

**Parameters.**
- `purchase_id` — the reference number of the purchase record (one unit of one item) the Finch Note was redeemed on, as returned by the purchase lookup for this customer; identifier text.
- `amount` — the total refunded by this entry; USD, 2 decimal places, positive, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed; never empty.

Neither parameter takes an enumerated value.

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the new price adjustment reference number (an opaque text reference), the purchase record reference number, the amount refunded (USD, 2 decimal places), the tender refunded, and the unit's remaining amount paid and not refunded (USD, 2 decimal places). A sentence starting with "Finch Note shortfall refund booked" means the entry was recorded.
